scientific_integrity: Analytical proof uses the classical rooted-forest matrix-tree count. Exactly enumerated small cases and exact rational algebra checks are corroboration, not a substitute for proof. Previously known endpoint-degree law is credited.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled Cayley trees and first conditional moment only; no claim for other tree models, full conditional distribution, stochastic order, or independent historical priority.
title: A cube-root mode for leaf counts conditioned on marked distance in Cayley trees
